name: lcars
description: A framework-agnostic LCARS design system: CSS tokens, layout frames, components and an optional tiny JS helper.
rules: Load `lcars.css`; optionally load `lcars.js` with `<script type="module">`. Put `class="lcars"` on `<html>` (or on the wrapper of the LCARS part of a page).

Build pages as `.lcars-app` > one or more `.lcars-frame`. The standard page is a header frame (bottom elbow) followed by a body frame (top elbow) whose `__side` holds navigation and whose `__main` holds content.
Frame parts (`__elbow-top`, `__bar-top`, `__side`, `__main`, `__elbow-bottom`, `__bar-bottom`) must be direct children of `.lcars-frame`. Omit the parts you don't need; never wrap them.

Finish every `__side` with a filler `
` (or put it between items) so the sidebar reaches the elbow.
Bars contain empty `` segments (weight with `.lcars-grow-N`), optionally a `.lcars-bar__title`, and usually a `.lcars-round-end` cap on the last segment.

Color pieces with classes, never with `background-color`. Use role classes (`lcars-c-primary|secondary|tertiary|accent|muted|alert`) so themes work; use swatch classes (`lcars-c-orange`, …) only for colors that must not change with the theme, and `lcars-c-green` / `lcars-c-alert` for status meaning. For a one-off color set `style="--lcars-c: #hex"`.

Navigation = `<a class="lcars-block">` inside `__side`, current page marked `aria-current="page"`. Actions = `<button class="lcars-button">` in content, or `<button class="lcars-block">` inside sidebars. Toggles use `aria-pressed`, tabs use `role="tab"` + `aria-selected`.
Group content in `.lcars-bracket` cards laid out with `.lcars-grid`; use a `.lcars-bar` with a `.lcars-bar__title` as a section heading.
Forms: ``. Show errors with `aria-invalid="true"` plus a `.lcars-hint`.
Write labels in normal case; CSS uppercases headings and controls. Keep labels short (1–2 words). Decorative numeric codes such as `04-2291` in elbows/blocks are optional flavor.
Customize by overriding tokens (`--lcars-side`, `--lcars-bar`, `--lcars-gap`, roles, …) on `:root` or an element. Your own unlayered CSS always beats the framework; never use `!important`.
Pick a series look with `data-lcars-theme` on `<html>` (or any element for a scoped look). Theme ids: tng (default), tos, snw, dis, ent, ds9, voy, nemesis, ld, pro, pic, red-alert.
Animate only with `.lcars-pulse` / `.lcars-blink` or `data-lcars-cascade`; they switch off automatically for reduced-motion users.
`lcars.js` is optional and attribute-driven; it must be served over http(s), auto-upgrades elements added later (SPA-safe) and is safe to import during SSR.

mistakes.dont: Wrapping frame parts in extra `<div>`s or placing them outside `.lcars-frame`
mistakes.do: Make every `lcars-frame__*` element a direct child of its `.lcars-frame`.

mistakes.dont: `style="background: #f90"` on a block, button or elbow
Only swatch classes (`lcars-c-orange`) everywhere, so theme switching changes nothing
Sidebar stops short of the bottom elbow

mistakes.do: Sidebar items are rectangles: use `.lcars-block` (as `<a>` or `<button>`).

mistakes.dont: Paragraphs, inputs or large text inside a bar
mistakes.do: Bars are one `--lcars-bar` tall: put only segments and one short `.lcars-bar__title` in them.
Use `<button class="lcars-block">` or `<a class="lcars-block" href>` so it is focusable and gets hover/active states.

mistakes.dont: Hand-written CSS for gaps, radii or fonts

mistakes.do: Use a single `.lcars-app` per page; nest `.lcars-frame`s inside `__main` instead.

mistakes.dont: A wide `.lcars-table` straight in the page (overflows phones)
Opening a page that loads `lcars.js` from `file://`
mistakes.do: Serve it over http (`npm run dev`, any static server).

decisions.use: `.lcars-app` with a header frame and a body frame (recipe: app-shell)

decisions.need: LCARS chrome on top of an existing app

decisions.use: `.lcars-bracket`, or a nested `.lcars-frame` with both elbows for a heavier panel
`<dialog class="lcars-dialog">` wrapping a bracket or frame (recipe: dialog)

decisions.need: Custom shapes or a widget (e.g. the circular X/Y control)
decisions.use: Inline `<svg class="lcars-svg">` with `.lcars-c-*` on shapes and `role="button"` on clickable ones (recipe: svg-control)
`data-lcars-sound` on a container; `LCARS.beep("alert")`; your own files via `LCARS.setSounds({...})`
`.lcars-table` with `.lcars-num` numeric cells and `.lcars-pill` statuses (recipe: data-table)

components.name: Page scope
components.summary: Opt-in page styles: black background, LCARS font, text color, heading/link/code styles. Components work without it.

classes.lcars: Applies page-level LCARS typography and background to this element and its descendants.

components.name: App shell
components.summary: Full-viewport vertical stack of frames; the last child grows to fill the screen.

classes.lcars-app: Full-height column with gaps between frames. One per page.

components.name: Frame
components.summary: The sidebar + elbow + bar construction that defines LCARS. A 2-column grid; every part is optional. Header frame = bottom parts only; body frame = top parts only; panel = both.

classes.lcars-frame: Grid container. Its --lcars-c colors both elbows unless an elbow has its own color class.
classes.lcars-frame--right: Mirror: sidebar and elbows on the right.
classes.lcars-frame__elbow-top: Top corner piece (outer curve top-left) with arm and inner fillet drawn automatically. Optional short label sits bottom-right. May be <div>, <a> or <button>.
classes.lcars-frame__elbow-bottom: Bottom corner piece (outer curve bottom-left). Optional label sits top-right.
classes.lcars-frame__bar-top: Bar next to the top elbow; behaves like .lcars-bar.
classes.lcars-frame__bar-bottom: Bar next to the bottom elbow; behaves like .lcars-bar.
classes.lcars-frame__side: Vertical stack of .lcars-block items between the elbows. Add a .lcars-grow block as filler.

vars.--lcars-elbow-reach: Length of the elbow arm past the sidebar.
vars.--lcars-elbow-rx: Horizontal radius of the outer curve.

components.a11y: Use landmark elements: <header> for a header frame, <nav aria-label> for __side navigation, <main> for the page's primary __main.
components.example:
02-4471
Home Logs
…

components.name: Block
components.summary: The basic colored rectangle with its label in the bottom-right corner. Sidebar items, bar segments, swatches, big square buttons.

classes.lcars-block: Solid colored slab; label bottom-right; hover/active/focus states when it is an <a>, <button> or <label>.
classes.lcars-block--top: Label at the top instead of the bottom.
classes.lcars-block--start: Label at the start (left) instead of the end.

components.states: aria-current / aria-pressed="true" / aria-selected="true" / .is-active → active color; disabled / aria-disabled="true" → dimmed.
components.example: Sensors

components.name: Button
components.summary: Pill-shaped control for actions in content areas. Label bottom-right.

classes.lcars-addon: Black number plate inside a button or block, colored with the parent's --lcars-c.

components.name: Bar
components.summary: Horizontal strip of segments separated by thin gaps. Segments share width equally unless weighted.

classes.lcars-bar__title: Heading text sitting in the bar on the background color (use on h1–h6 or span). Does not stretch.
classes.lcars-bar__fixed: Stops a segment from stretching; give it a width.

components.example: Engineering

components.name: Bracket
components.summary: Content between rounded [ ] brackets — the LCARS card/panel.

classes.lcars-bracket: Card with brackets on both sides.
classes.lcars-bracket--start: Bracket on the start side only.
classes.lcars-bracket--end: Bracket on the end side only.

components.example:
Sector

Alpha quadrant

No anomalies detected.

components.name: Typography
components.summary: Text components that work anywhere (headings, links and code are also styled automatically inside .lcars).

classes.lcars-label: Small uppercase caption in the accent color.
classes.lcars-pill: Small rounded status tag (tertiary by default).
classes.lcars-list: List with block-shaped bullets; color items with .lcars-c-*.

components.example:
Main engineering

Status Nominal
  • Warp core
  • Impulse

components.name: Meter
components.summary: Segmented level bar driven by --lcars-value (0–1). With lcars.js, aria-valuenow/min/max drive it automatically.

classes.lcars-meter--vertical: Vertical; give the parent a height.

components.name: Data
components.summary: Numeric displays: the dense decorative number field and a key/value readout.

classes.lcars-data: Grid of numbers in mixed palette colors. Fill it yourself or add data-lcars-cascade="N" (lcars.js) to generate and animate N cells.

components.a11y: lcars.js marks cascades aria-hidden; don't put real data in a cascade.

components.name: Table
components.summary: Data table with colored header rule, row caps and hover highlight.

classes.lcars-table: Styled table; add .lcars-num to numeric <th>/<td> for right alignment.
classes.lcars-table--scan: A highlight sweeps down the rows (the LCARS scanning effect). Off for reduced-motion users.

vars.--lcars-scan-duration: Time for one sweep of 12 rows (default 4s).

components.a11y: Wrap tables that can be wider than a phone in <div class="lcars-scroll" tabindex="0" aria-label="…">.

components.name: Forms
components.summary: Restyled native controls. aria-invalid="true" switches a control to the alert color.

classes.lcars-field: Stack of label, control and hint. Use on <label> (or a <div> with a proper <label for>).
classes.lcars-hint: Small muted helper / error text under a control.
classes.lcars-switch: Checkbox rendered as a toggle switch.
classes.lcars-choice: <label> wrapping a check/switch and its text.

components.name: Dialog
components.summary: Styles a native <dialog> as an LCARS modal. Open with dialog.showModal(); close with <form method="dialog">.

classes.lcars-dialog: Black modal surface with dark backdrop; put a bracket or frame inside.

components.example: Confirm self-destruct

components.name: SVG
components.summary: Inline SVG that follows LCARS colors, themes and states — for shapes CSS boxes can't draw, such as the circular X/Y control. Shapes without a fill attribute are painted with --lcars-c.

classes.lcars-svg: On the <svg>. Paints path/rect/circle/ellipse/polygon/polyline with --lcars-c (so .lcars-c-* works on shapes) and styles shapes with role="button" as controls.

components.states: role="button" shapes: hover/active brightness, focus ring (stroke), aria-pressed/aria-selected/aria-current → active color, aria-disabled="true" → dimmed.
components.a11y: Give the <svg> role="group" and an aria-label; give each clickable shape role="button", tabindex="0" and an aria-label. lcars.js makes Enter/Space click them.
components.example:
<svg class="lcars-svg" viewBox="0 0 80 80" width="160" role="group" aria-label="Scanner">
  <path class="lcars-c-accent" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="Up" d="m34 10h12v-9.5c-3.9-.5-8-.5-12 0z"/>
  <path class="lcars-c-tertiary" d="m11 34v12h23v23h12v-23h23v-12h-23v-23h-12v23z"/>
</svg>

components.name: Layout helpers
components.summary: Small layout primitives. All use --lcars-space for spacing.

classes.lcars-split: Row with items pushed to both ends.
classes.lcars-grid: Responsive auto-fit grid; min column width --lcars-grid-min.

classes.lcars-grow: flex-grow: 1 — bar segment weight / sidebar filler.

classes.lcars-scroll: Horizontal scroll container for wide content such as tables; add tabindex="0" and an aria-label.

classes.lcars-sr-only: Visually hidden, still read by screen readers.

states.appliesTo: frame elbows, bar segments, sidebar items

states.effect: Applies a theme to that subtree.

tokens.name: --lcars-primary
tokens.description: main frame color; default for most pieces

tokens.name: --lcars-secondary
tokens.description: second frame color; brackets default to it

tokens.name: --lcars-tertiary
tokens.description: third color; inputs, meters, tables, pills

tokens.name: --lcars-case
tokens.description: text-transform for headings and controls; "none" for mixed case

tokens.name: --lcars-gap
tokens.description: the thin black gaps between pieces

tokens.name: --lcars-elbow-reach
tokens.description: how far the elbow's arm reaches past the sidebar

tokens.name: --lcars-inner-radius
tokens.description: inner fillet where arm meets bar

attributes.effect: Live 24h clock HH:MM:SS; value "hm" drops seconds.
Generates N random readouts and animates them.
Switches the page theme on click ("" = default).
Fills itself with every theme and switches on change.
Clicks on interactive descendants play that sound (default tap; entering red alert plays red-alert); "off" disables.
Overrides the sound for that element.
Enter / Space activate it like a button.

js.description: Upgrade LCARS elements inside scope. Idempotent.
Apply a theme id ("" or null = default). Fires "lcars:theme".
Enter/leave red alert; no argument toggles. Restores the previous theme. Fires "lcars:alert".
Play a console sound: tap (acknowledge), confirm (alternate acknowledge), deny (negative acknowledge), alert, red-alert or ready. Synthesized unless setSounds() gave it a file.
Use your own audio files for any sound, e.g. setSounds({ "red-alert": "/sfx/klaxon.ogg" }); null restores the synthesized one.
Array of the built-in sound names.
Array of { id, name, era, note } for every theme.

events.when: Dispatched (bubbling) on the element whose theme changed.
Dispatched (bubbling) when red alert starts or ends.

recipes.title: App shell
recipes.summary: Full-page layout — header frame + body frame with sidebar navigation. Start every LCARS app from this.

recipes.title: Header only
recipes.summary: A single header frame to put LCARS chrome above an existing (non-LCARS) app. Scope with class="lcars" on the header's wrapper if the rest of the page keeps its own styles.

recipes.title: Sidebar navigation
recipes.summary: Body frame whose sidebar holds the main navigation — current item marked with aria-current, a filler block, and an action pinned to the bottom.

recipes.title: Dashboard tiles
recipes.summary: Grid of bracket cards showing KPIs with readouts and meters. Put this inside a frame's __main.

recipes.title: Section heading
recipes.summary: A bar with a title used to divide a page into sections, followed by the section content.

recipes.title: Data table
recipes.summary: Table with a heading bar, status pills, numeric columns and row actions.

recipes.title: Form
recipes.summary: Settings form in a bracket — text, select, textarea, switch, checkbox, range, a validation error and submit/cancel.

recipes.title: Tabs
recipes.summary: Segmented control / tabs built from small buttons with role="tab" and aria-selected; a few lines of JS switch panels.

recipes.title: Dialog
recipes.summary: Modal confirmation using a native <dialog class="lcars-dialog">; the frame inside gives it LCARS chrome.

recipes.title: SVG control
recipes.summary: The classic circular X/Y control as inline SVG — shapes colored with .lcars-c-* classes, each quadrant and arrow a keyboard-accessible button. Geometry adapted from upstream's widget by jrwarwick (MIT).
